Gypsy Rose Blanchard's Partner Ken Urker Found Dead

Ken Urker, the partner of Gypsy Rose Blanchard, was found dead inside his home in Raceland, Louisiana. Deputies responded to the residence after Urker did not respond to a birthday text message and was found "dead upon arrival," according to the Laforche Sheriff’s Office. Gypsy Rose Blanchard has broken her silence regarding the death of her fiancé.
